purpose: Read-only, selected-vehicle component prognostics: next service, component health and a deterministic health forecast with confidence bounds.
primaryGoal: Identify components needing attention, select a component, and interpret its remaining life without mistaking a model projection or missing history for a measured failure date.

dataSources.name: Component health board
dataSources.behavior: Query key ['rul', vehicleId]; enabled only for positive non-null IDs; analytics stale time; request cancellation signal forwarded. Board components and next_service are server supplied, not locally predicted.

dataSources.name: Selected component forecast
dataSources.behavior: Independent query key ['rul-component', vehicleId, component]; disabled without both scope inputs. Response contains basis, EOL threshold, nominal-life references, notes and date/health/lower/upper projection points. Unknown keys produce 400 and unconfigured known components produce 404 in source.

dataSources.name: Deterministic diagnostic inputs and limitations
dataSources.behavior: Configs come from component_lifespans. HV battery uses a 400-day signal_log EnergyRemaining/BatteryLevel daily reconstruction and estimated nominal pack capacity. Tires/brakes use lifetime drive odometer plus a 90-day accumulation rate, without service resets. LV battery/filter use enrollment age, not replacement records. Battery confidence is R-squared times sample adequacy; wear confidence is sample-count adequacy; age confidence is capped at 0.6. Forecast bands are deterministic heuristic envelopes, not independently established probabilistic intervals.
dataSources.units: Inspected RUL DTOs actually expose km and days despite their SI-canonical comment. Preserve this deferred contract; remaining_km is multiplied by 1000 only at the existing useUnits display boundary. Do not migrate backend units during presentation work.

dataSources.name: Workspace vehicle selection and client
dataSources.behavior: Shared URL/store/fleet vehicle precedence; no duplicate local picker. request adds /api/v1. No date-range selector exists here; model lookback/horizon are backend-owned, not workspace historical filtering.

components.name: PageLayout → PageContainer
components.contract: Inherited shell scope, full allocated width, container layout, header/title/help, board-query freshness and page error isolation; do not replace.

components.name: NextServiceBrief → OperationalBrief
components.contract: Two text metrics, source/scope/freshness/status, real missing values, Review details and closeable details drawer; narrative score remains not_scored unless actual source supplied.

components.name: SelectableCard
components.contract: Native button, selected state, caller role/name, visible focus and min-h-11; selection semantics need coordinated improvement.

components.name: LinearGauge, MetricBar, StatusPill
components.contract: Health meter, confidence progressbar and textual status; preserve numeric values and missing semantics. Gauge tone and MetricBar solid fill are existing APIs.

components.name: EmbeddedChart → ChartContainer
components.contract: Fluid, embedded chart, source-backed accessibility table/description capability. Export/fullscreen default false in EmbeddedChart and are not existing RUL actions.

components.name: Skeleton, EmptyState, QueryError, StaleRefreshWarning, FadeIn
components.contract: Use current feedback category and individual retry; preserve retained source warnings. FadeIn honors shared motion preference.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Local domain status metadata repeats color/tone presentation responsibilities. Its RUL classifications and translation keys are genuinely domain-specific; cross-page duplication was not established by this bounded audit.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep RUL status mapping local but delegate presentation tones to existing shared APIs; do not introduce a second universal status registry.

sourceBehavior.detail: Cards use one column, md two, xl three; no sections are deliberately hidden on mobile.
Chart height is h-72 then sm:h-80; responsive width, minTickGap=28 and 44px Y axis.
Brief stacks until xl, wraps header metadata/actions and compact metric grid starts one column.

issues.detail: Health readout remains w-32 shrink-0 beside a three-row definition list with no narrow-card stacking rule. At 320px or narrow shell allocation, long localized dt/dd pairs can compress severely; actual overflow is unverified.
issues.fix: Use a narrow container-width stack/reflow while retaining every health/remaining/distance/date field; test 320/375/390/430 and narrow tablet columns with long translations.

issues.detail: Confidence label/readout depend on MetricBar's non-wrapping justify-between header; long localized labels compete with percentage/category text.
issues.fix: Exercise long labels and 200% text zoom; if confirmed across consumers, add an opt-in wrapping header to the existing MetricBar rather than hide confidence.

positiveEvidence: Board is a named section; card names are localized; decorative icons use aria-hidden (page:166,168,208,213).
SelectableCard is a native button with focus-visible ring/min-h-11 (SelectableCard.tsx:34-43).
Health and confidence have numeric meter/progressbar semantics (LinearGauge.tsx:211-225; MetricBar.tsx:59-66).
Statuses include visible text, not color alone (page:218-220).
Stale warnings use polite live status and retry (StaleRefreshWarning.tsx:88-115).

issues.detail: Cards have role=option and aria-selected from SelectableCard, but their parent grid is a plain div, not a listbox/group implementing the listbox keyboard contract. Native button activation is available, but option containment is source-invalid.
issues.fix: Prefer native toggle-button semantics with aria-pressed in a named group for rich cards, or implement a complete shared listbox contract including parent role and arrow-key navigation. Preserve selection, names and full card metadata.

issues.detail: The no-table comment claims the composite is not tabular, although projection points contain explicit date/projected/lower/upper values. EmbeddedChart receives neither data/dataColumns nor ariaDescription; ChartContainer falls back to 'Chart: title'. Its accessible label describes shape but exposes no actual forecast values or confidence bounds.
issues.fix: Pass actual projection rows with date, projected health, lower bound and upper bound through the existing data/dataColumns contract plus a source-backed explanation. Retain EOL, band, basis and chart; no fabricated readings.

issues.detail: Forecast Line sets animationDuration=700 without using shared motion preference; confidence Area disables animation and FadeIn/MetricBar already honor preference. Recharts animation behavior under OS reduction is not exercised.
issues.fix: Apply useMotionPreference to the existing Line isAnimationActive/duration; retain all forecast data and curve geometry.

issues.detail: Page passes query for freshness but no loading/busy/error values. PageContainer's useLoadAnnouncement consumes loading/error props, not query (PageContainer.tsx:135-141); therefore page-owned initial loading transitions are not wired to that shared announcer. Whether child feedback supplies equivalent announcements is unverified.
issues.fix: Wire a non-destructive busy/announcement contract or existing scoped announcer for board/detail transitions without globally gating all sections.

inventory.name: No vehicle
inventory.behavior: Queries disabled; brief requests workspace selection; board/forecast show selection prompts.

inventory.name: Initial loading
inventory.behavior: Five 188px board skeletons; 340px forecast skeleton; brief loading suppression.

inventory.name: Board fatal failure
inventory.behavior: Board QueryError and board retry; brief reports failure; no page-wide fatal gate.

inventory.name: Empty/no active component
inventory.behavior: Dedicated board and chart empty messages; headers stay mounted.

inventory.name: Retained refresh failure/offline
inventory.behavior: Nonfatal warnings retain prior board/detail payload with per-source retry; offline retained content is explicitly described.

inventory.name: Unknown/indeterminate prognosis
inventory.behavior: Absent replace-by date does not expose remaining_days sentinel; distance null displays dash; actual zero confidence remains zero. Backend default health and flat forecasts require explanation, not invented measurements.

issues.detail: Any retained board without a projected next-service date says 'all components healthy'. NextServiceDue skips all null dates (prognostics.go:468-484), including overdue components whose builders deliberately omit dates. No projectable date does not prove healthy.
issues.fix: Use neutral 'No service date projected' language, retaining actual board statuses/confidence/basis and source limitations; do not alter deterministic diagnostic calculations.

issues.detail: Only selected detail basis is displayed, and only inside the nonempty-chart branch. Board entries already carry basis but do not show it. Empty/unconfigured forecast states can hide the very rationale distinguishing an estimate from absent history.
issues.fix: Keep selected source basis visible independently of chart availability and make each card's existing basis reachable; preserve the details action and confidence labels without fabricating provenance.

issues.rule: MDC-026 distinguish model defaults from observations
issues.detail: Backend BatteryRUL's missing-history branch returns health_pct=0, confidence=0, healthy status but forecast inputs at 100 (prognostics.go:324-330); unconfigured wear/age return healthy 100 with no configuration (380-385,429-433). UI prints these numbers as health with little card-level evidence. These are existing server semantics, not data invented by this audit.
issues.fix: Expose existing basis and inference limitation; request explicit availability metadata from the diagnostic owner before distinguishing missing numeric health from measured zero. Do not guess from confidence alone or change server math in page work.

issues.detail: Unrecognized runtime status silently maps to Healthy despite statusMeta accepting arbitrary strings. The inspected typed server emits four known values, so this is a defensive-contract risk rather than a confirmed current response.
issues.fix: Preserve the four classifications but provide a localized neutral unknown fallback instead of asserting healthy.

visualIssues.detail: Electric cyan #22d3ee confidence bars, hardcoded #34d399/#fbbf24/#fb7185/#f87171 gauges/series, saturated rose EOL text and a 25% gradient band bypass semantic theme tones. Colors encode statuses, but intensity and fixed theme behavior need modernization. Runtime visual/contrast impact remains unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse semantic gauge tones/current palette and existing MetricBar fill=solid for confidence; subdue EOL annotation while preserving status distinctions, confidence bounds and custom chart preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Shared selected/focus presentation uses fixed cyan borders/rings and bg-white/[0.02]/[0.04] surfaces. Low-alpha white is not pure-white body text, but it is fixed-white decoration rather than theme surface tokens; rendered contrast was not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Shared owner should preserve interaction and focus but resolve selected/hover/focus presentation from existing theme/surface/border tokens; do not page-override each consumer.

visualIssues.detail: Overdue dots request pulse; StatusPill emits animate-pulse (StatusPill.tsx:27) with no local motion-safe condition. This is repeated ambient animation, not essential overdue information; global CSS/OS behavior was not inspected or exercised.
visualIssues.fix: Retain overdue text/semantic severity without constant pulse, or ensure shared preference-aware behavior if explicitly required elsewhere.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-013/MDC-044 role typography and date formatting
visualIssues.detail: Forecast component subtitle bypasses role Text with text-sm/font-normal and fixed toned accent. Replace-by values and chart month ticks are raw ISO/slice formatting (248,323), unlike localized numbers.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing typography/date presentation helpers, retaining exact dates, source values and translated units; avoid reinterpreting date-only data as local timestamps.

architectureIssues.detail: Local selected key remains across vehicle changes and wins over every new board's next_service/first component. With the current fixed five-component backend this retains a valid selection, but partial/missing config can lead to a detail 404 while board still renders all specs. Whether sticky component selection is intended is not established.
architectureIssues.fix: Document/test retention versus reset behavior and validate against new source components without removing the existing explicit-select/default precedence.

architectureIssues.detail: DTO comment calls km/days SI-canonical, but actual fields are remaining_km/nominal_life_km/remaining_days. The page intentionally adapts km to metres for useUnits. This is a known integration boundary, not authorization to rename or rescale wire/cache values during a visual migration.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep raw contract and display conversion unchanged; any later SI migration belongs to the coordinated backend/API owner with contract tests.

priority.reason: First correct misleading all-healthy summary and missing diagnostic availability/provenance presentation, then invalid option semantics and accessible forecast values; visual restraint and mobile reflow follow without changing deterministic models.

requiredSharedChanges.name: SelectableCard theme and complete selection semantics
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Retain selected, disabled, name, native activation and forwarded button props. Add/document native aria-pressed selection mode or a complete listbox composition; use semantic selected/hover/focus tokens and retain >=44px target.
dependsOn: Existing accessibility interaction policy; inventory other consumers before shared semantic changes

requiredSharedChanges.name: Explicit RUL diagnostic availability metadata
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Source owner to define measured/inferred/unavailable/config-missing input evidence for health and projection, preserving current numbers, confidence, basis, deterministic math and wire units. Do not infer missingness solely from confidence=0.

competingImplementations.detail: Page uses category barrels, shared layout, query/data-trust, workspace scope, formatting and domain brief. Local status colors are presentation duplication; no alternate query/store/theme/formatter engine was found within inspected scope. MetricBar wrapping need is conditional QA, not a confirmed new shared implementation requirement.

sections.name: Next service due
sections.preserve: Component/date metrics, true missing date, source, snapshot freshness, selected-vehicle scope, loading/error/retained states and Review details drawer.

sections.name: Component health board
sections.preserve: Stable server order and all five tracked identities where supplied; health/status/remaining/distance/replace-by/confidence; card selection, loading, error, empty, no-vehicle states.

sections.name: Health forecast
sections.preserve: Selected component title, actual projection date/health/confidence bounds, range Area, Line, EOL reference, axis domain, tooltip, basis and independent state/retry.

preservation.countInterpretation: Four GlassPanel tags include three mutually exclusive board fallback branches and one forecast panel; not four simultaneous sections. Shared brief includes its own GlassPanel and details drawer.

actions.name: Choose workspace vehicle
actions.preserve: Shell-owned selection; no local duplicate control.

actions.name: Select component forecast
actions.preserve: Explicit selection, then next-service default, then first server component.

actions.name: Retry board and detail fatal failures
Refresh retained stale sources
actions.preserve: Source-specific retry and disabled refreshing state.

actions.name: Review next-service details and close drawer
actions.preserve: Real source metrics, provenance and existing shared narrative/details renderer.

actions.name: Inspect chart tooltip
actions.preserve: Health percentage and lower-upper percentage formatting.

dataBehavior: No frontend model inference or generated forecast points; render server projection unchanged except [low,high] tuple folding.
Both sources use inferred provenance; preserve actual source confidence and explanatory basis, never replace with fabricated certainty.
Preserve server deterministic OLS/rate/status/projection math and model limits: no service reset, enrollment age proxy, nominal pack estimate and flat/default-horizon behavior.
Keep null replace-by/distance distinct from zero; do not show capped remaining_days sentinel as a real date.
Keep km/day wire values as currently contracted; convert remaining_km to metres only for useUnits display.
Preserve saved numeric precision, units, localization, raw labels/data and independent query enablement/keys/stale policies/cancellation.
Do not add export, fullscreen, schedule-service mutations or AI prediction actions absent from this source.
